A wide deep highland gorge at a vigorous narrow growing stream. EXACTLY TWO fully clothed adult healers stand firmly on a BROAD DRY ochre-paper bank; one kneels slightly and lifts/carries ONE small infant safely wrapped in plain cream/green folded PAPER band, head supported in forearm, the other receives/supports it. No floating baby, unattended infant in water, nursing scene, dead carers or medical treatment. Infant is alive, calm, fully wrapped with only a tiny simple closed-eye paper face. Principal elder wears the plain modest gold-paper hat as a specifically narrated historical variant, no crown or jewel; both adults have muted green/charcoal simple layers.
The growing river is overlapping broad pale-blue and dark-blue PAPER RIBBONS curving through close cliffs, gentle angular spray-paper accents, no photographic froth. Humans small in environment, all adult feet on visible dry land, daylight with shifting cloud strata. Show reception and responsibility, not a spectacular rescue accident or religious tableau.
